scientific_status: reviewed synthesis will qualify unsupported assertions

review.summary: Comparison of the completed MACE-OFF and MACE-MP Brev model outputs reveals severe model-to-model inconsistencies, with relative stiffnesses differing by up to 5.77-fold (sulfilimine) and 5.60-fold (HLNL). The claim that dityrosine is unconditionally the stiffest crosslink is contradicted by raw MACE-OFF output where HLNL achieves k_rel = 16.29 due to a conformational relaxation shift (+18.8% strain). Furthermore, gas-phase neutralizations and boundary polyfit artifacts distort relative stiffness estimates, making these raw MLIP values unsafe for direct tissue network parameterization without explicit solvent PMF controls.

findings.title: HLNL Outstiffs Dityrosine in MACE-OFF Due to Unconstrained Minimum Shift
findings.evidence: In MACE-OFF, HLNL off_k_rel reaches 16.29 compared to dityrosine's 4.31, with the global minimum shifting to index 16 (+18.8% strain).
findings.implication: Falsifies the claim that dityrosine is unconditionally stiffest across all raw model outputs.
findings.recommended_check: Inspect ETKDG starting conformers and enforce local minimum validation before applying axial stretch scans.

findings.title: Severe Inter-Model Discrepancies in Relative Stiffness Predictions
findings.evidence: Sulfilimine k_rel varies 5.77-fold (0.60 in MACE-OFF vs 3.49 in MACE-MP) and HLNL varies 5.60-fold (16.29 vs 2.91).
findings.implication: MLIP foundation model outputs are uncalibrated for gas-phase crosslink fragments and cannot serve as quantitative inputs for tissue-level mechanics.
findings.recommended_check: Benchmark MLIP strain energy profiles against high-level QM (e.g. revPBE-D4 or DLPNO-CCSD(T)) fragment scans.

findings.title: Polynomial Fitting Artifacts on Boundary Minima
findings.evidence: analyse() fits a 2nd-order polynomial using 5 points centered on np.argmin(e), which hits grid boundary index 0 (-6.0% strain) for MACE-OFF sulfilimine.
findings.implication: Calculated stiffness constants near grid edges reflect artificial asymmetric sampling rather than true harmonic wells.
findings.recommended_check: Reject scan runs where the energy minimum is at or adjacent to boundary grid points.

findings.title: Neutralization of Charged Pyridinium Cores Alters Relative Baseline
findings.evidence: Pyridinoline is modeled as a neutral pyridinone proxy fragment to avoid unpassivated ionic charges in gas-phase calculations.
findings.implication: Removing formal charge alters backbone electrostatics and distorts the denominator (pyridinoline k) used for all relative k_rel normalizations.
findings.recommended_check: Compute solvation free energies and explicit-water potentials of mean force (PMF) for charged native structures.

review.strongest_surviving_claim: Qualitatively, oxidative crosslinks with short, rigid aromatic/biphenyl cores (dityrosine) exhibit higher conformational axial rigidity than long, flexible aliphatic chains (isopeptide_TG2) when both are evaluated near their local relaxed minimum.
review.decisive_next_experiment: Perform umbrella sampling / steered molecular dynamics (SMD) in explicit solvent with counterions using periodic collagen triple-helix fragments crosslinked by dityrosine vs glucosepane vs pyridinoline, extracting PMF curves and stiffness constants from converged harmonic force distributions.
